units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 4) in closed administrative-territorial entities;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 5) in science towns;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 6) in border territories;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 7) in the territory of the Skolkovo Innovation Centre;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 8) in priority development territories;
units.label: Point 8 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 9) in the territories of innovative scientific and technological centres;
units.label: Point 9 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 10) in the territory of the Free Port of Vladivostok;
units.label: Point 10 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 11) in municipalities whose territories form part of the Arctic Zone of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 11 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 12) in territories with a low rural population density and in remote and hard-to-reach localities;
units.label: Point 12 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 13) in the territory of the ERA Military Innovation Technopolis of the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 13 Art. 86

units.locator: Article 86. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in particular territories
units.text: 14) in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization.

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.label: Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 1. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance shall be established by laws of those constituent entities of the Russian Federation, taking into account the provisions of this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 2. In cities of federal significance, local self-government shall be exercised by local self-government bodies in intracity municipalities of the city of federal significance in accordance with the charters of those constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 3. Specific features of determining the type of municipality in the territories of cities of federal significance shall be determined by laws of cities of federal significance.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 4. The charter of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance may, in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance, provide that the head of the municipality simultaneously holds a state office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and a municipal office.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 5. The charter of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance may provide for the formation of an executive-administrative body headed by the head of the municipality who exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 6. The provisions of part 6 of Article 10 of this Federal Law do not apply to intracity municipalities of a city of federal significance.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 7. The provisions of part 8 of Article 15 and parts 7–10 of Article 59 of this Federal Law do not apply to the local self-government bodies of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance in which, under the charter of that municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 8. The requirement to terminate the powers of a deputy of the representative body of a municipality established by part 4 of Article 19 of this Federal Law does not apply to a deputy of the representative body of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance elected head of the municipality in which, under the charter of that municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 9. The restrictions established by part 16 of Article 19 and part 2 of Article 28 of this Federal Law do not apply to the local self-government bodies of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance, except where the head of the municipality is elected by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the competition commission following a competition.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 10. The number of deputies of the representative body of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance shall be determined by the charter of the municipality in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance and may not be fewer than 10 persons.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 11. The representative body of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance may have the rights of a legal entity in accordance with the charter of the municipality.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 12. In cities of federal significance, the boundaries of intracity municipalities of the corresponding cities of federal significance shall be established and changed, and those municipalities reorganized, by laws of cities of federal significance, taking into account the opinion of the population of the corresponding intracity municipalities of the city of federal significance expressed in accordance with the procedure provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 13. The list of powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life and the sources of local budget revenue of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance shall be determined by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance, based on the need to preserve the unity of the urban economy.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 14. Sources of local budget revenue established by this Federal Law and other federal laws that are not assigned by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance to the sources of budget revenue of intracity municipalities shall be credited to the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 15. The powers of local self-government bodies shall be exercised by the local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance where the corresponding powers are assigned to the powers of the local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 16. The procedure for making public municipal legal acts of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance, including agreements concluded between local self-government bodies, shall be established by the charter of the intracity municipality of the city of federal significance in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance and shall ensure that citizens can acquaint themselves with those acts, except for municipal legal acts or individual provisions thereof containing information whose dissemination is restricted by federal law.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 17. In the territories of cities of federal significance, the organization of territorial improvement and upkeep, approval of rules for territorial improvement and upkeep, and assignment of powers to exercise municipal control in that field, the subject of which is compliance with those rules, including requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of social, engineering and transport infrastructure facilities and services provided, to the powers of local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life or to the powers of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance as powers to exercise a type of regional state control (supervision), shall be regulated by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 18. In accordance with laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance, based on the need to preserve the unity of the urban economy and the established list of powers of local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life, a local administration need not be formed in such municipalities.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 19. Laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance may provide for specific features of the exercise of individual state powers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance transferred to local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance, where exercising those powers will not require expenditure from the budgets of cities of federal significance and/or local budgets or material resources.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 20. The composition of municipal property of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance shall be determined by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance in accordance with the list of powers of local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities of cities of federal significance to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life established for those municipalities by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 21. The procedure for proposing, submitting, discussing and considering initiative projects and for conducting their competitive selection in the territories of cities of federal significance shall be established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 22. In cities of federal significance, the scope of powers of a person temporarily exercising the powers of head of a municipality, appointed by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance in the cases provided for by this Federal Law, may be limited by the charter of the municipality to the extent provided for by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance and/or by the regulatory legal act of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance appointing the person temporarily exercising the powers of head of the municipality.
units.label: Part 22 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 23. A decision of the representative body of a municipality on removal of the head of the municipality from office shall be signed by the chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 23 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 24. Where, under the charter of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality, consideration of removal of the head of the municipality from office at a meeting of the representative body of the intracity municipality of the city of federal significance shall take place under the chairmanship of a deputy of the representative body of the intracity municipality of the city of federal significance authorized for that purpose by the representative body of that municipality. The decision on removal of the head of the municipality from office shall be signed by the deputy chairing the meeting of the representative body of the intracity municipality of the city of federal significance.
units.label: Part 24 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 87. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are cities of federal significance
units.text: 25. Where, under the charter of an intracity municipality of a city of federal significance, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality, the deputy elected head of the municipality and exercising their powers on a full-time basis under the charter of the municipality shall be counted when determining the number of deputies of the representative body of the municipality who may work on a full-time basis in accordance with part 12 of Article 25 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 25 Art. 87

units.locator: Article 88. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 88. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 88

units.locator: Article 88. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. A municipality whose territory includes a settlement that is the administrative centre (capital) of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be an urban okrug.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 88

units.locator: Article 88. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in the territories of administrative centres (capitals) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The head of a municipality whose territory includes a settlement that is the administrative centre (capital) of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be elected by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 88

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.label: Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 1. The specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization established by this Article shall apply in constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with part 7 of Article 9 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 2. In municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization, local self-government shall be exercised in rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities and municipal raions. In territories of a municipal raion located outside the boundaries of settlement municipalities on the date this Federal Law enters into force, specific features of the organization of local self-government shall be established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 3. A rural settlement municipality is a municipality whose territory includes one or more rural settlements united by a common territory (settlements, villages, stanitsas, hamlets, khutors, kishlaks, auls and other rural settlements) that are not municipalities. The territory of a rural settlement municipality may also include territories intended for the development of its social, transport and other infrastructure.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 4. An urban settlement municipality is a municipality whose territory includes a city and/or another urban settlement that are not municipalities. The territory of an urban settlement municipality may also include the territories of rural settlements that are not municipalities and territories intended for the development of its social, transport and other infrastructure.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 5. A municipal raion is a municipality whose territory includes several settlement municipalities united by a common territory, within whose boundaries local self-government is exercised for the purpose of exercising the powers of local self-government bodies to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life that are of an intersettlement nature. The territory of a municipal raion may also include territories outside the boundaries of settlement municipalities.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 6. The provisions of this Federal Law shall apply to rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities and municipal raions subject to the specific features provided for by this Article.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 7. The provisions of part 7 of Article 10 of this Federal Law do not apply to rural settlement municipalities and urban settlement municipalities.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 8. The charter of a rural settlement municipality may provide for the formation of an executive-administrative body headed by the head of the municipality who exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 9. The charters of a municipal raion and of the settlement municipality that is its administrative centre may provide for the formation of a local administration of the municipal raion entrusted with exercising the powers of the local administration of that settlement municipality. In that case, no local administration shall be formed in the settlement municipality that is the administrative centre of the municipal raion; the head of the settlement municipality shall be a member of its representative body and exercise the powers of its chair.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 10. In accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the charter of the municipal raion, the representative body of a municipal raion:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 1) may consist of the heads of settlement municipalities forming part of the municipal raion and deputies of the representative bodies of those settlement municipalities elected by their representative bodies from among their members in accordance with an equal representation quota irrespective of the population of the settlement municipality. If the head of a settlement municipality is elected by its representative body from among candidates nominated by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the competition commission following a competition, that head of the settlement municipality shall not be a member of the representative body of the municipal raion; in addition to the deputies it has elected under that representation quota for settlement municipalities, the representative body of that settlement municipality shall elect one additional deputy from among its members to the representative body of the municipal raion of which that settlement municipality forms part. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and, pursuant to it, the charter of the municipal raion and the charters of settlement municipalities may establish a representation quota for settlement municipalities forming part of the municipal raion in the representative body of that municipal raion based on the population of the settlement municipality. The representation quota of one settlement municipality forming part of the municipal raion may not exceed one third of the established membership of the representative body of that municipal raion;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 2) may be elected at municipal elections on the basis of universal, equal and direct suffrage by secret ballot. The number of deputies elected from one settlement municipality may not exceed two fifths of the established membership of the representative body of the municipal raion.
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 11. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation provides for a transition from election of the representative body of a municipal raion at municipal elections to its formation from among the members of representative bodies of settlement municipalities, elections of deputies of that municipal raion shall not be called or held if that law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation entered into force before the date from which the representative body of the municipal raion would be entitled to adopt a decision calling elections in accordance with Federal Law No. 67-ФЗ of 12.06.2002 “On the Basic Guarantees of Electoral Rights and the Right of Citizens of the Russian Federation to Participate in a Referendum”. The procedure for formation of the representative body of the municipal raion thus established shall apply after expiry of the term of powers of the representative body of the municipal raion elected before the date that law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation entered into force.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 12. If a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation provides for a transition from formation of the representative body of a municipal raion from among the members of representative bodies of settlement municipalities and intracity districts to election at municipal elections, elections to the representative body of the municipal raion shall be held no later than six months from the date that law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation enters into force, unless otherwise provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 13. The number of deputies of the representative body of a municipal raion shall be determined by the charter of the municipal raion and may not be fewer than 15 persons.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 14. The charter of a settlement municipality may, in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, provide that the head of the municipality simultaneously holds a state office of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and a municipal office.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 15. When a competition is held to select candidates for the position of head of a settlement municipality, half of the members of the competition commission shall be appointed by the representative body of the settlement municipality and the other half by the head of the corresponding municipal raion.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 16. In the case provided for by part 9 of this Article, when a competition is held to select candidates for the position of head of a municipal raion, one quarter of the members of the competition commission shall be appointed by the representative body of the municipal raion, one quarter by the representative body of the settlement municipality that is the administrative centre of the municipal raion, and half by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 17. The provisions of part 8 of Article 15 and parts 7–10 of Article 59 of this Federal Law do not apply to the local self-government bodies of a rural settlement municipality in which, under the charter of that municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 18. The requirement to terminate the powers of a deputy of the representative body of a municipality established by part 4 of Article 19 of this Federal Law does not apply to a deputy of the representative body of a rural settlement municipality elected head of the rural settlement municipality in which, under the charter of that municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 19. The restrictions established by part 16 of Article 19 and part 2 of Article 28 of this Federal Law do not apply to the local self-government bodies of a rural settlement municipality, except where the head of the municipality is elected by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or by the representative body of the municipality from among candidates nominated by the competition commission following a competition.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 20. In the case provided for by part 9 of this Article, the contract terms concerning the exercise of powers to address matters of directly supporting the population’s daily life for the head of the local administration of the municipal raion who is entrusted with exercising the powers of head of the local administration of the settlement municipality shall be approved by the representative body of the municipal raion with the agreement of the representative body of that settlement municipality.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 21. When a competition is held to fill the position of head of the local administration of a settlement municipality, half of the members of the competition commission shall be appointed by the representative body of the settlement municipality and the other half by the head of the local administration of the corresponding municipal raion.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 89
